project: LEXIGEN V8 Interventional Performance World Model
purpose: Repair weaknesses exposed by the immutable R1 synthetic audit before any real corpus is collected.

new_controls.no_cross_terms: Contains both program and intervention feature blocks plus categorical intervention/language features but no program×intervention products.
new_controls.global_permutation_ensemble: Three independently permuted target sets; fold-local metrics must remain near chance.
new_controls.stratified_permutation_ensemble: Three target permutations performed independently within intervention_family × repository_family strata, preserving coarse base rates while destroying row-level conditional pairing.
new_controls.macro_fold_metrics: Primary null AUROC/Spearman are computed inside each held-out fold and macro-averaged, preventing held-out-group prevalence differences from inflating pooled AUROC.
new_controls.heldout_intervention_family: Leave one intervention family out of fitting; categorical identity is unseen and only transferable numeric intervention/program structure can support prediction.
